appearance_facts.fact: A vertical blue bar for January extends from the x-axis (y~1590) up to y~1095, aligning with the 225 level on the y-axis.
A vertical blue bar for February extends from the x-axis (y~1590) up to y~1140, aligning with the 190 level on the y-axis.
A vertical blue bar for March extends from the x-axis (y~1590) up to y~470, aligning with the 530 level on the y-axis.
A dashed horizontal line spans the plot width at the 225 level, labeled 'Average' on the right side (x~2050, y~1070).
The chart title 'Number of Customers at Mall A in Town X' is displayed in large black text.

printed_facts.fact: The y-axis is labeled 'Number of Customers' with tick marks at 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500, 550, and 600.
The x-axis is labeled 'Month' with categories 'January', 'February', and 'March'.
The text 'Average' is printed next to the dashed horizontal line at the 225 level.
The January bar reaches a value of 225, which is exactly on the 'Average' line.
The February bar reaches a value of 190, which is below the 'Average' line.
The March bar reaches a value of 530, which is significantly above the 'Average' line.

public_definitions: Use the Mall A customer traffic dashboard as the evidence source for the January traffic route.
Review the Mall A customer traffic dashboard for January through March, then choose the January route in the monthly traffic operations form.
